preregistration_scope: Future independent participant study only; known R1/R2/R2B synthetic results cannot be retroactively preregistered
independent_unit: participant; all trials, visits and linked records stay in one split
coverage_requirements: Same participant and experienced event episodes; direct order measurement rather than proxy duration or factual-calendar knowledge
Independent engagement and recognition eligibility checks, source-specific cutoffs frozen before outcome access
Fixed comparable external task norms and expected mismatch offsets calibrated under identical eligibility; instrument reliability, documented chronology and retention delays
For secondary latent-model comparison: at least three parallel-block indicators each for recognition, order and delayed recall

primary_analysis.population: Independent eligible complete paired observations in locked holdout; no selection on target outcomes
primary_analysis.test: Two-sided one-sample Student t tests of participant paired contrasts
primary_analysis.assumptions: Independent participants; approximately normal paired differences; fixed validated normative transforms and eligible-reference expected-contrast offsets
primary_analysis.selection_calibration: Reference must apply identical engagement/recognition eligibility; unselected task Z norms alone do not remove recognition-selection bias; calibration uncertainty requires redesign before access
primary_analysis.interpretation: A task mismatch is not selective individual dissociation, clinical diagnosis, equivalence, mechanism or awareness proof

multiplicity.secondary_methods_and_profile_counts: Exploratory descriptive estimates; no confirmatory clinical p values; amendments required before adding confirmatory hypotheses

power.method: Deterministic numerical noncentral paired-t power; stdlib quadrature; tested against independent reference values
power.final_gate: Before outcome access freeze feasible source-specific N/cap and justify effect, SD, correlation, reliability, missingness and clustering assumptions

holdout.split: Custodian freezes person-level seed and private split manifest before outcome access; stratify by site and independently known strata
holdout.leakage_prevention: No holdout access by model developers until transformations, exclusions, fit and analysis are locked; all visits/trials remain together
holdout.clustering: Linked records remain together; site/family recruitment clusters require design and power amendment before access

secondary_specific_profile.sequence_specific: Adequate independent engagement; recognition and delayed-recall lower95 measurement intervals>Z -0.5; order upper95 interval<Z -1.5; >1Z target-nontarget gap; repeated in separate parallel-form assessment
secondary_specific_profile.recall_specific: Same rule with temporal order and delayed recall exchanged
secondary_specific_profile.mixed: Both weak target domains remain mixed
secondary_specific_profile.failure_rule: No profile confirmation without external norm/measurement uncertainty and repeat reliability; never loosen cutoffs after outcomes

competing_models.M_shared: Single common encoding/memory factor across nine block indicators; fixed scale/sign, block intercepts and diagonal positive residual variances
competing_models.M_separable: Same common factor plus orthogonal order- and recall-specific factors; each on three domain indicators; zero cross-loadings, unit variance and positive anchors
competing_models.pre_access_gate: Synthetic parameter/model recovery and Jacobian/rank identification checks of the exact implementation and source indicator design
competing_models.fit: Parameters trained on development only; optimizer, restarts, seed, convergence and regularization frozen before holdout unlock
competing_models.evaluation: Holdout participant-wise conditional log likelihood for six order/recall indicators given recognition and covariates; calibration/residual checks; participant-bootstrap intervals
competing_models.claim_ceiling: Predictive measurement-model comparison only; no unique causal neural mechanism or consciousness inference

real_data_gates.source_and_rights: Verified custodian, provenance/checksum, dictionary, license, consent scope or independent waiver, lawful access/storage and retention/publication rights
real_data_gates.coverage: Private approved audit of same-person task linkage, chronology, direct measurements, independent records, norms and reliability
real_data_gates.ethics: Independent committee review; accessible informed consent, capacity assessment, lawful representative consent where needed, assent, dissent and withdrawal respected
real_data_gates.prospective_registration: Public protocol/source-specific supplement before recruitment and before archival outcome access; dated amendments and prior-summary disclosures
real_data_gates.privacy_safety: Approved private roles/access/audit; no patient rows or raw email in public repository; fatigue/distress stop rules; care independent of research
real_data_gates.runtime: No participant-file input to R2B; separate approved private implementation needed for future study

literature_limit: p=.15 with n=11/13 is inconclusive without an equivalence design; nonsignificance proves neither absence/equivalence nor, by itself, insufficient power
